entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help me. I need to... I need to return something I bought a little while ago. I just feel so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. The order number is VF88-12590.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the order for the VeloFit Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just... they're not working for me. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for these cycling shoes. But no matter what I do, they give me terrible blisters on my heels. I even struggled to get the cleats on right. I just can't wear them.
I understand. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm looking at your delivery date... it was 76 days ago.
Oh, I know it's been a while. I kept trying to make them work, I really did. With things being so tight lately, I was just hoping I could get a refund. I really needed this money back.

Of course. Let me just check our policy for you. One moment... Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that our standard return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery. Since you're at day 76, you are still well within the window for a return.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news! I was so worried. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, we will process a full refund to your original payment method.
That is such a relief. You've been so helpful, Diana. Thank you again.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for your VeloFit products?
No, that's everything. You've made my day!
Great to hear. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
